behaviour: jsdom tests for page actions, the tab bar, rendering/selection scoping, per-page viewport, undo scoping and search across pages.
rules: Render <Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally /> in beforeEach after mockBoundingClientRect (as viewMode.test.tsx does) and restoreOriginalGetBoundingClientRect in afterEach.

Run actions with API.executeAction(action) or h.app.actionManager.executeAction(action, "api", value) inside act; query tab bar elements by their data-testid and role inside GlobalTestState container / document; drive drag with fireEvent.dragStart/dragOver/drop.
Elements on a page are created with API.createElement({ ..., pageId }) and set with API.setElements; for the default page omit pageId.
Render scoping uses vi.spyOn(StaticScene, "renderStaticScene") and reads the visibleElements of the last call's first argument.

uses.reason: how search is opened and its input queried

tests.name: starts with one default page
tests.given: a fresh editor
tests.expect: h.state.pages has one visible page Page 1 and the tab bar shows one tab with aria-selected true

tests.name: add page via the + button
tests.given: click pages-add-button
tests.expect: two visible pages, the new one named Page 2 is active and its tab is aria-selected

tests.name: switch page via a tab click
tests.given: two pages, click the first tab
tests.expect: activePageId is the first page and selection is cleared

tests.name: rename page inline
tests.given: double-click the active tab, type "SDK flow", press Enter
tests.expect: the page name is SDK flow; a second rename to blank spaces plus Enter keeps SDK flow; Escape cancels an edit

tests.name: delete page via the menu
tests.given: two pages with a rectangle on the active one, open the menu and click delete
tests.expect: one visible page remains, the rectangle isDeleted, the adjacent page is active; with one page the delete entry is disabled

tests.name: reorder via move right and via drag
tests.given: pages A, B, C; move A right from the menu, then drag C onto the first tab
tests.expect: visible order becomes B, A, C and then C, B, A

tests.name: only the active page renders
tests.given: rectangle r1 on the default page and r2 on page p2
tests.expect: renderStaticScene visibleElements contain r1 only, and r2 only after switching to p2

tests.name: select-all and click selection ignore other pages
tests.given: r1 on the active page and r2 overlapping it on another page
tests.expect: Ctrl+A selects r1 only; clicking where r2 lies selects nothing on page B's coordinates when r2 is the only element there

tests.name: new elements land on the active page
tests.given: switch to a second page and draw a rectangle with the UI
tests.expect: the new element's pageId is the active page

tests.name: per-page viewport is restored
tests.given: scroll and zoom on page A, switch to B, change its viewport, switch back
tests.expect: A's scrollX/scrollY/zoom are restored and B's are restored when returning to B; a never-visited page starts at 0,0 zoom 1

tests.name: undo stays on its page
tests.given: move r1 on page A, switch to B, move r2, switch back to A, undo
tests.expect: r1 returns to its position, r2 keeps its moved position, activePageId stays A; switching to B and undoing reverts r2

tests.name: switching page is not an undo step
tests.given: switch pages twice then undo with an empty stack
tests.expect: activePageId does not change

tests.name: search finds text on another page and switches to it
tests.given: a text "pipeline" on page B while A is active, search for pipeline
tests.expect: one match; focusing it sets activePageId to B

tests.name: tab bar hidden in zen mode and via UIOptions
tests.given: zenModeEnabled true, then render with UIOptions pages false
tests.expect: no pages-tab-bar in the DOM in both cases

tests.name: view mode can switch but not edit pages
tests.given: two pages and viewModeEnabled true
tests.expect: tabs switch the page; no add button and no menu trigger

behaviour: Serialization, restore and export tests for multi-page drawings.
rules: Pure functions only: serializeAsJSON, restoreAppState, restoreElements, loadFromBlob over a Blob built from the serialized JSON, prepareElementsForExport and toActivePageExportState; no editor render needed except where loadFromBlob needs window (jsdom is the default environment).

style_from.reason: data test imports and restore usage

tests.name: round trip keeps pages, names, order, elements and viewports
tests.given: two pages (A, B with fractional indexes), elements on both, pageViewports for B and a live viewport on active A, serializeAsJSON then loadFromBlob
tests.expect: pages, names and order equal; each element keeps its pageId; pageViewports holds A's live viewport and B's saved one

tests.name: legacy file restores onto one default page
tests.given: a file JSON without appState.pages and elements without pageId
tests.expect: restored pages is exactly one default page, activePageId is DEFAULT_PAGE_ID and every element is on it

tests.name: elements of an unknown page restore onto the first page
tests.given: a file whose element pageId is not in pages
tests.expect: after loadFromBlob the element is on the first visible page

tests.name: older readers keep the data
tests.given: restoreElements on an element with pageId p2
tests.expect: pageId p2 is kept; a pageId of "default" is dropped

tests.name: export contains only the active page
tests.given: elements on two pages and appState.activePageId = A, prepareElementsForExport(elements, appState, false)
tests.expect: exportedElements holds only page A's elements

tests.name: embedded scene holds only the active page
tests.given: toActivePageExportState over an appState with two pages
tests.expect: pages has only the active page record and pageViewports only its entry

behaviour: Adds collaboration tests for page structure and per-page elements.
rules: New describe block "collaboration pages" at the end of the file reusing the file's mocks; render <ExcalidrawApp />, start collaboration with window.collab.startCollaboration(null) inside act, then drive remote updates through the private applyRemotePages and handleRemoteSceneUpdate methods via bracket access (with eslint-disable-next-line dot-notation as the file does).
Spy on window.collab.portal.broadcastScene with vi.spyOn to assert outgoing payloads.

tests.name: remote page records and elements apply
tests.given: a remote pages list adding page p2 named Data pipeline and a remote element with pageId p2
tests.expect: h.state.pages contains p2 with that name, the element is in h.elements, and the local activePageId and scroll are unchanged

tests.name: concurrent rename resolves by version
tests.given: local rename of a page to X (version 2) and a remote record with version 3 named Y
tests.expect: the page is named Y

tests.name: local page changes are broadcast
tests.given: adding a page locally while collaborating
tests.expect: broadcastScene is called with a pages argument containing the new page

behaviour: Documents the page fields of the .excalidraw format.
rules: Add a `### Pages` section after the JSON Schema example: appState.pages (records id, name, index, version, versionNonce, isDeleted; order by index), appState.activePageId, appState.pageViewports ({ [pageId]: { scrollX, scrollY, zoom } }), element.pageId (absent = page "default"); legacy files without pages load as one page named Page 1; version stays 2; exported PNG/SVG with an embedded scene carry only the active page.
Add `"pageId": "p2"` to the example element is not needed; instead add `"activePageId": "default"` and a one-page `"pages"` array to the example appState.

sites.rule: Keep both keys and add activePageId and a one-entry pages array to the example.
Insert the Pages section with an attribute table.

behaviour: Changelog entry for drawing pages under Unreleased.
rules: Add `### Pages in a drawing` under `## Unreleased` before the exportScene entry: a tab bar to add, switch, rename, reorder and delete pages; per-page elements, viewport and undo; new AppState keys pages/activePageId/pageViewports and element.pageId; `UIOptions.pages: false` hides the tab bar; `getSceneElements()` now returns every page's elements; exports DrawingPage, PageViewport and the page helpers/actions; file format version unchanged.

sites.rule: Insert the new section followed by a blank line.

behaviour: Regenerates the AppState snapshots of the editor tests that now include the page fields.
Regenerates the embedded-scene export snapshots whose payload now carries the page fields.
